what: SHA-256 of the six reference files written by loomora_refgen (basic, empty, escape40, multi, multi-light, one). Reference = the six hashes of the golden constants of core/tests/format_selftest.cpp, held once in the files stored under validation/evidence/adr-0021/windows-11-x64/. Files byte-identical to the reference are not stored again (ADR 0014); only their hash is recorded here.
platform_note: BUILT FOR API 9, RUN ON API 16 ONLY, on one emulator (Android emulator 37.2.13.0, AVD API16 = system image android-16 default x86, Android 4.1.2, 1,024 MB, WHPX, headless, on the Windows 11 host of the spec 002 work). Nothing below API 16 was run: this proves bytes and logic on x86 under Android 4.1.2, not Android 2.3 to 4.0 and not any ARM ABI. The sizes are those of the reference files: the run recorded the six SHA-256 (core/tests/android_results.json / web_results.json of the main repository), not the sizes, and an equal SHA-256 means equal bytes.
